import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def qpow(a, b, mod):
    res = 1
    tp = a
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = (res * tp) % mod
        tp = (tp * tp) % mod
        b >>= 1
    return res

def cal(a, b, fac, inv, mod):
    return (((fac[a] * inv[b]) % mod) * inv[a - b]) % mod

def calc(n, k, fac, inv, mod, dp, inf):
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod
    inv[n] = qpow(fac[n], mod - 2, mod)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[1][i] = inv[i]
    ans = (dp[1][n] * cal(k, 1, fac, inv, mod)) % mod
    t = min(17, k)
    for i in range(2, t + 1):
        for j in range(1 << n):
            dp[i][j] = 0
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            dp[i][1 << (j - 1)] = inv[j]
        for j in range(1, 1 << n):
            if dp[i - 1][j] == 0:
                continue
            r = ((1 << n) - 1) ^ j
            l = r
            while l:
                l = (l - 1) & r
                if l == 0:
                    continue
                dp[i][j | l] += dp[i - 1][j] * inv[bin(l).count('1')]
                if dp[i][j | l] > inf:
                    dp[i][j | l] %= mod
        for j in range(1 << n):
            dp[i][j] %= mod
        ans += dp[i][(1 << n) - 1] * cal(k, i, fac, inv, mod)
        ans %= mod
    fac[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod
    return ans

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    mod = int(data[2])
    inf = 17446744073709551616
    dp = [[0] * (1 << n) for _ in range(19)]
    fac = [0] * (n + 1)
    inv = [0] * (n + 1)
    ans = pow(k, n, mod)
    if n % 2 == 0:
        def calc_value():
            return calc(n, k, fac, inv, mod, dp, inf)
        ans = (ans - calc_value() + mod) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
